description: Module names MicroPython firmware provides on the ports ThingStudio supports (ESP32 family, RP2, nRF, STM32, unix). A user library with one of these names is refused (SPEC.md section 4). Built-in library names and runtime module names are refused too, but are not listed here: they come from runtime_manifest.py (DEPENDENCIES, CORE_FILES) so they cannot drift.
